summary: Delta Air Lines filed an 8-K to report entering into a new $2.650 billion revolving credit facility, refinancing its existing credit agreement. The facility includes three-year and five-year tranches of $1.325 billion each, plus a separate standby letter of credit facility. Borrowings bear variable interest based on adjusted term SOFR plus a margin. This is a routine refinancing of corporate debt for general corporate purposes, not a special situation. The filing lacks any event triggering a special-situation category; it is purely a material definitive agreement and direct financial obligation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation element is present.
